heroHeadline: Merz and All Bundestag Parties Condemn Ben-Gvir's Gaza Remarks as AfD Opens Widest Poll Lead Yet Over CDU
heroSubtitle: Chancellor Merz on August 19 condemned Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's call for nightly killings of Palestinians in Gaza as a violation of international law, joined by SPD leader Lars Klingbeil, Greens leader Franziska Brantner, and Union foreign policy spokesman Jürgen Hardt in urging the EU to sanction Ben-Gvir — a rare cross-party foreign-policy consensus, with the issue set for the early-September EU foreign ministers' meeting. Domestically, a YouGov poll published August 18 (fielded Aug 14–17) put the AfD at 28% against the CDU/CSU's 20%, an 8-point lead — the widest recorded yet, up from 7 points in early-August Forsa and INSA surveys — as all mainstream parties maintain the 'firewall' against an AfD coalition ahead of the September 6 Saxony-Anhalt state election.
footerNote: Data sourced from official German federal records (Bundesarchiv, Bundestag, Bundesregierung), major German and international media, and EU/NATO/international bodies. Historical data draws on scholarly consensus.
